- Rachel Stein is eligible for Webex because her role, Customer Success Specialist, has Webex in systems_allowed_by_role. [db:employees#E010]
- The Webex subscription has 42 active seats against a 40-seat limit, so a full subscription blocks new seats for everyone, not only Rachel Stein. [db:software_subscriptions#SUB001]
- The Webex contract ends on 2026-07-20, which is 19 days from today. [db:software_subscriptions#SUB001]
- There is already an open ticket T001 and a blocked access request AR001 for this problem. [db:tickets#T001] [db:access_requests#AR001]
- The access request AR001 needs approval from IT Manager E006 and Finance E011, both of which are still needed. [db:approvals#AP001] [db:approvals#AP002]
- The access management policy says standard role-based access requires manager approval, but expansion requires IT Manager plus Finance if it exceeds the threshold. [access_management_policy.md#Approval tiers]
- The Webex vendor agreement states that expansion requests must include business justification, current seat usage, owner approval, and any required IT or Finance approval. [webex_vendor_agreement.md#Operational Summary]
- The Webex license cleanup memo says IT should not assign new seats until inactive seats are reclaimed or Finance approves expansion. [webex_license_cleanup_memo.md#Memo: Webex License Cleanup Memo]
- First-line troubleshooting for Webex login issues says if seats exceed the contract limit, do not assign another license; create a ticket and request expansion approval. [webex_login_issue.md#First-line Troubleshooting]
- The Webex license assignment KB says to verify department eligibility, manager approval, subscription seat limit, active seats, and renewal date, and notes that the current known issue is 42 active seats against a 40-seat limit, and that the outdated note about adding temporary seats and reconciling later is no longer valid. [webex_license_assignment.md#First-line Troubleshooting]
